printing-niimbot.name: Niimbot printer
printing-niimbot.description: Prints labels straight to a Niimbot B1 — from this browser over Bluetooth, or from the server through Home Assistant.

driver.name: Niimbot B1
driver.haRoute: Printed by this workshop through Home Assistant on {printer}
driver.haRouteSole: Printed by this workshop through Home Assistant

settings.title: Niimbot B1
settings.description: One printer, two ways to reach it: this browser over Bluetooth, or the server through Home Assistant.
settings.unsupported: This browser has no Web Bluetooth, so it cannot reach the printer. Chrome or Edge can — on a desktop or on Android.

density.label: Density
density.help: How hard the printhead burns the label: 1 is the lightest, 5 the darkest.

labelType.label: Label stock
labelType.help: Match the roll loaded in the printer, or it will not find where one label ends.

device.label: Last printer
device.help: The printer this browser last printed on. Bluetooth asks which device to use each time the browser has not been granted one.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot reach a Bluetooth printer.
errors.connection: Could not reach the printer. Check it is on, in range, and not connected to the Niimbot phone app.
errors.badRaster: The label could not be prepared for printing.
errors.tooWide: The label is wider than the printhead ({max} dots).
errors.noPaper: The printer is out of labels.
errors.lowBattery: The printer's battery is too low to print.
errors.batteryException: The printer reported a battery fault.
errors.userCancel: Printing was cancelled on the printer.
errors.dataError: The printer rejected the label data.
errors.overheat: The printhead is too hot. Let it cool down.
errors.paperOutException: The printer could not feed the label.
errors.printerBusy: The printer is busy with another job.

handoff.title: Print a label
handoff.previewLabel: The label that will be printed
handoff.gone: This link has already been used or has expired. Ask for a new one from the app.
handoff.done: Printed. You can close this page.

errors.gone: This print link is no longer valid.

handoff.unsupported: This browser cannot reach a Bluetooth printer either. Open this same link in Chrome or Edge — on a desktop or on Android — next to the printer.

handoff.create: Park a rendered label and return a one-time print link
handoff.claim: The parked label behind a print link
handoff.printed: Mark a print link as used after a successful print
handoff.rows: Base64 of the packed 1-bpp rows (MSB first, a set bit is ink)
handoff.copies: How many copies of the page to print

ha.read: Which Home Assistant printer this instance prints on
ha.write: Save the Home Assistant printing settings
ha.printers: The hass-niimbot printers this instance's Home Assistant knows
ha.preview: Render a test page through Home Assistant without printing it
ha.printerName: The entity's own name, remembered for the print dialog
ha.soleTarget: Send no target, for a Home Assistant with exactly one printer
ha.sendSize: Send the page size with the job
ha.targetId: The hass-niimbot device, or one of its entities, to send the label to
ha.targetKind: Whether the target is a device or an entity

print.read: How the printer prints: density and label stock
print.write: Save the density and label stock
print.density: How hard the printhead burns the label (1–5)
print.labelType: Label stock loaded in the printer

ha.title: Through Home Assistant
ha.description: Print from the server instead of from this browser: Home Assistant talks to the printer, so a phone with no Bluetooth of its own can print too.
ha.adminOnlyNote: Printing through Home Assistant is set up by an administrator.
ha.noBridge: The Home Assistant plugin is turned off, so there is no connection to print through.
ha.unconfigured: Home Assistant has no address or token yet.

printer.label: Printer
printer.help: The Niimbot that Home Assistant looks after.
printer.unfiltered: The list could not even be narrowed to hass-niimbot, so every entity this Home Assistant knows is in it.
printer.empty: No hass-niimbot printer was found on this Home Assistant. Install the integration and add the printer there first.
printer.entities: This Home Assistant could not be asked which printers hass-niimbot looks after, so its entities are listed instead — pick the one that prints.
printer.only: The only printer this Home Assistant has.

soleTarget.label: Let Home Assistant pick the printer
soleTarget.help: It prints on its only Niimbot. Use this where the printers could not be listed above.

sendSize.label: Send the page size
sendSize.help: Off lets Home Assistant take the size from the roll's own label lookup instead.

ha.previewOk: The printer answered, and the page went through.
ha.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
ha.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.

errors.noBridge: There is no Home Assistant connection to print through.
errors.noEntity: No Home Assistant printer has been chosen.
errors.integrationMissing: This Home Assistant has no hass-niimbot integration installed.
errors.badRaster: The label could not be prepared for printing.
errors.encodeFailed: The label could not be turned into an image.
errors.payloadTooLarge: The label came out too large to send to Home Assistant.
errors.pageSize: Home Assistant cannot render a page this size.

ha.previewAlt: The test page Home Assistant drew
ha.previewNotPrinted: Nothing was printed — a label comes out only when you print one.
ha.previewFailedDevice: Home Assistant could not reach the printer.
ha.previewFailedRender: The printer answered, but the page did not go through.

print.title: Print
print.description: How the printer burns and what is loaded in it. The same for every way of sending a job below.
print.adminOnlyNote: An administrator sets these: one printer, one roll in it.
print.saveFailed: The print settings could not be saved.
print.carriedOver: The density and label stock this browser remembered are now the instance’s.

routes.title: Where to send the job
routes.description: These are the destinations the print dialog offers. The print settings above apply to all of them.

browser.title: This browser
browser.help: This browser talks to the printer itself, over Bluetooth. The device it was granted belongs to this browser alone.
